[SWS_DM_02039] Reporting successful communication control to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service CommunicationControl is received, which re-
sults in a positive response, the DM shall report a security event
SEV_UDS_COMMUNICATION_CONTROL_SUCCESSFUL to IdsM (see [26] and
table [SWS_DM_02040]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02040].
⌋
